target.role: Senior Manager, Capital Planning, Research and Portfolio Analytics

summary: Portfolio analytics and asset-allocation specialist with ~7 years of institutional experience, applying for Senior Manager, Capital Planning, Research and Portfolio Analytics. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio risk outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement at Moody's Analytics. Advised pension funds on strategic and tactical asset allocation, delivered VaR/CVaR optimization, risk decomposition, and leverage-overlay and hedging analysis at Ortec Finance, presenting findings directly to investment committees. CFA charterholder, dual MSc, advanced Excel and Python.

sections.heading: Portfolio Risk Analytics & Stakeholder Reporting
bullets: Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and portfolio analytics delivered to multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before release.
Reviews aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream balance-sheet and capital processes.

Prepares analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on scenario impacts, interest-rate exposure, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into investment committee-ready narratives.

sections.heading: Scenario Analysis & Liquidity Planning
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across multi-year planning horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset allocation decisions.
Oversees duration and interest-rate sensitivity analysis under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, and embeds behavioural cash flow assumptions and macro stress overlays into projection scenarios.

sections.heading: Stakeholder Partnership & Governance
bullets: Serves on the model governance committee, contributing to methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

Acts as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing directly with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders; re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into auditable Python analytics pipelines.

Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating to the PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management) platforms.
Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, scoping requirements into development requests and validating model outputs post-deployment.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning reporting requirements with system implementation and governance documentation.
Coordinated across actuarial, finance, IT, risk, and program-management teams on milestone delivery and implementation materials.

Advised Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors on Strategic and Tactical Asset Allocation to meet long-term return and risk objectives, using stress testing and sensitivity analysis to navigate allocation risk.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk budgeting, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test the robustness of allocation recommendations.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing macroeconomic, interest-rate, and funding-volatility exposure under base-case and stressed environments.

Led the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger on a team of three, evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies while validating all funding-policy dynamics.
Performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest-rate, inflation, and currency risk for international institutional clients.
Presented study findings and allocation recommendations on-site to investment committees at Canadian pension-fund clients.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
